summary.text: Michael Gentile is the Republican and Conservative Party candidate for New York State Assembly District 119 in the November 3, 2026 general election, having won the Republican primary on June 23, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Gentile ran for the same Assembly seat in 2020 as the Serve America Movement Party candidate and received 273 votes, or 0.6 percent, in the general election won by incumbent Marianne Buttenschon.
Ballotpedia reports that he had not completed its 2026 Candidate Connection survey.
